concepts.gloss_en: being able to gaze upon the ultimate purpose (tachlis)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the identical phrase 'he can look upon the ultimate purpose' from the same lesson (lm1:65), differing only by the demonstrative 'הזה' (this) — a modifier, not a different word or homograph. Both describe the same act of directing one's gaze toward the tachlis by closing the eyes to this world.
